import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

df = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv')

# Combine primary and secondary breeds, drop missing values
breeds = pd.concat([df['Rasse1Text'], df['Rasse2Text']]).dropna()

# Count frequencies and select top 10 breeds
breed_counts = breeds.value_counts().nlargest(10)

# Create horizontal bar plot
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 8))
sns.barplot(x=breed_counts.values, y=breed_counts.index, palette='viridis')
plt.title('Top 10 Dog Breeds in Zurich (2019-2025 Registrations)', pad=20)
plt.xlabel('Number of Registrations')
plt.ylabel('Breed')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
